description: Labeled channel messages with explicit Agent mentions for the mention-scope Jev question. `expected` is `mentioned` when only the mentioned Agents should receive the message (narrowing is correct) and `others` when an unmentioned Agent is plausibly addressed (narrowing would wrongly exclude it). Asides to humans stay `mentioned`; ambiguous cases lean `others` because excluding an addressed Agent is the costly error.
